popCulture.title: Antiope (mother of Amphion)
popCulture.description: The Theban Antiope endures as the oppressed mother of Amphion and Zethus — Zeus' beloved who fled, suffered under Dirce, and was avenged by her twin sons.

popCulture.title: Dirce
popCulture.description: Antiope's tormenter remains tied to the Farnese Bull — Dirce bound to the bull by Amphion and Zethus in one of antiquity's most famous revenge images.
